blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Monday said that no one will attempt to smuggle illegal drugs into the country if the government intensifies its crackdown against drug trafficking. Duterte made this remark when asked about her initial reaction to reports that a Filipino allegedly smuggled illegal drugs bound for the Philippines from Laos. Duterte already released a statement on Sunday on the issue, in which she expressed regret over the incident. “I feel embarrassed for our neighboring countries in Southeast Asia because we have become the center of drug trafficking in our region,” Duterte told reporters on the sidelines of the kick-off […]...
